scenes.title: Samsonov and Nina argue in bed
scenes.summary: Samsonov and Nina argue about his supposed infidelity after the concert. He threatens her with divorce.

scenes.title: Intro Song
scenes.summary: The opening credits and theme song play.

scenes.title: Osipenko asks for help
scenes.summary: Osipenko asks a politician for help dealing with Samsonov, but lacks the funds to bribe him.

scenes.title: Samsonov seeks advice
scenes.summary: Samsonov seeks advice from Arkady on his marriage and asks if he should get a divorce.

scenes.title: Eduard blackmailed
scenes.summary: Eduard Valentinovich is blackmailed by the FSB and asks Marina to flirt with him to save himself.

scenes.title: Packing Instructions
scenes.summary: Arkady instructs Samsonov to make a show of packing his things to scare Nina.

scenes.title: Nina mocks Samsonov
scenes.summary: Samsonov packs his things, but Nina mocks him in front of their kids instead of begging him to stay.

scenes.title: The 10-second stare
scenes.summary: Following Arkady's advice, Samsonov prepares to stare at Nina for 10 seconds before leaving for a hotel.

scenes.title: Leaving Home
scenes.summary: Samsonov kisses his kids goodbye and leaves for the hotel while Nina mocks him.

scenes.title: Eduard's alibi
scenes.summary: Eduard sets up an alibi with his wife over the phone while preparing to meet his mistress.

scenes.title: FSB instructs Marina
scenes.summary: The FSB instructs Marina on how to act during her date with Eduard to extract information.

scenes.title: Osipenko bribes Governor
scenes.summary: Osipenko bribes the Governor with money disguised as documents to help him crush Samsonov.

scenes.title: Divorce papers delivered
scenes.summary: A court official delivers actual divorce papers to Nina, making her realize Samsonov was serious.

scenes.title: Marina visits Arkady
scenes.summary: Marina visits Arkady with wine, but he refuses her company and plays chess by himself.

scenes.title: Governor sides with Samsonov
scenes.summary: The Governor sides with Samsonov and Arkady, betraying Osipenko.

scenes.title: Osipenko throws out trackers
scenes.summary: Osipenko realizes he's been played and throws out trackers from his case to avoid the FSB.

scenes.title: Marina flirts with Eduard
scenes.summary: Marina successfully flirts with Eduard in a restaurant while the FSB listens in.

scenes.title: Nina visits Samsonov
scenes.summary: Nina visits Samsonov at his hotel with food, but he plays hard to get.

scenes.title: Nina and Ilona fight
scenes.summary: Ilona shows up at the hotel room, resulting in a catfight between her and Nina over Samsonov.

scenes.title: Aftermath of the fight
scenes.summary: Nina and Ilona recover from their scuffle in the hotel room.

scenes.title: Osipenko confronts Borya
scenes.summary: Osipenko furiously confronts the Governor's aide to get his money back, but fails.

scenes.title: Marina questions Eduard
scenes.summary: Marina questions Eduard about his past and whether he takes bribes.

scenes.title: Arkady gets something back
scenes.summary: Arkady gets an item back from a guy in a brief encounter.

scenes.title: Discussing grief stages
scenes.summary: Samsonov and Arkady discuss the stages of grief and Nina's current emotional state.

scenes.title: Taking photos
scenes.summary: Someone takes photos outside to post online for likes.

scenes.title: Osipenko gets a warning
scenes.summary: Osipenko gets a stern warning from a general about his recent failures.

scenes.title: Nina regrets
scenes.summary: Nina expresses regret over losing Samsonov and discusses her options with Klavdiya.

scenes.title: Eduard caught
scenes.summary: Eduard falls completely into the FSB trap laid by Marina.

scenes.title: Samsonov at the campaign
scenes.summary: Samsonov works on his campaign, feeling confident about his recent successes.

scenes.title: Arkady's plotting
scenes.summary: Arkady continues to plot the next steps for Samsonov's political rise.

scenes.title: Osipenko desperate
scenes.summary: Osipenko grows increasingly desperate to salvage his political career.

scenes.title: Nina tries to apologize
scenes.summary: Nina tries to apologize to Samsonov, but he remains distant.

scenes.title: Eduard's confession
scenes.summary: Eduard confesses some of his secrets to Marina under the influence of alcohol.

scenes.title: The Governor's speech
scenes.summary: The Governor makes a public speech endorsing his chosen candidate.

scenes.title: Samsonov's victory
scenes.summary: Samsonov celebrates a minor victory in his campaign with his supporters.

scenes.title: Osipenko's defeat
scenes.summary: Osipenko accepts his defeat and contemplates his next move.

scenes.title: Nina alone
scenes.summary: Nina spends time alone with her kids, missing Samsonov.

scenes.title: Arkady's success
scenes.summary: Arkady celebrates the success of his intricate political machinations.

scenes.title: Outro Song
scenes.summary: The episode ends with the outro song playing over the credits.
